items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: I never knew the two that was playing. I remember the name now, Russell.

ctx.x: Paul Barbrin has a copy of the picture too. And we had borrowed one from Witten Joe Nicholas, the uncle of Albert Nicholas. And then this is Willie San Diego and Louis Russell, I believe, on piano.
I never knew the two that was playing. I remember the name now, Russell. Yes.
My daddy used to speak of him.
